description: Claude Code Observability Dashboard - Monitor usage, costs, and performance

panels.description:
One line per host. Each line is a running total of tokens used by that host across the selected time range — the height at the right edge is the host's total for the range.

Host comes from `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES="host.name=<hostname>"`. A machine that has not been configured reads `unknown`.

Reads with `increase(...[$__range])`, the same running-total method as **Cumulative Tool Usage** below. Wide ranges (weeks) make this query slower.
panels.title: Total Tokens by Host
Sessions — one row per session, newest first
panels.description:
One row per Claude Code session in the selected range.

**Host** comes from `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES="host.name=<hostname>"`, set on each client. Claude Code has no built-in hostname attribute, so a machine without this setting reads `unknown`. OS, arch and version stay blank unless `resource_to_telemetry_conversion` is enabled on the Prometheus exporter in `collector-config.yaml`.

Claude Code sends no session name, only `session_id`, so **Session** shows the raw ID.

**Active time** is real working time and is exact. Use it.

**Session time** is `Last seen − Started`. It shows how long the process ran, not how long you worked. A session left open in tmux spans days while its active time stays at minutes. It is also **up to `metric_expiration` too long** (24h with the shipped collector config) and never reads less than 10m: the collector holds each series after a session ends, and the timestamps come from a subquery with a 10-minute step. Do not read it as billable time.

Counters are read with `max_over_time`, so a collector restart in the middle of the range shows the peak, not the sum. Ranges longer than a few weeks are slow, because Started, Last seen and Session time are subqueries.

targets.expr: label_replace(topk by (session_id) (1, (count by (session_id, host_name, os_type, os_version, host_arch, terminal_type, service_version) (max_over_time({__name__=~"claude_code_(token_usage_tokens|active_time_seconds|cost_usage_USD)_total", job="otel-collector", host_name!=""}[$__range])) * 0 + 3) or (count by (session_id, host_name, os_type, os_version, host_arch, terminal_type, service_version) (max_over_time({__name__=~"claude_code_(token_usage_tokens|active_time_seconds|cost_usage_USD)_total", job="otel-collector", os_type!=""}[$__range])) * 0 + 2) or (count by (session_id, host_name, os_type, os_version, host_arch, terminal_type, service_version) (max_over_time({__name__=~"claude_code_(token_usage_tokens|active_time_seconds|cost_usage_USD)_total", job="otel-collector"}[$__range])) * 0 + 1)), "host_name", "unknown", "host_name", "^$")

max by (session_id) (max_over_time(timestamp({__name__=~"claude_code_(token_usage_tokens|active_time_seconds|cost_usage_USD)_total", job="otel-collector"})[$__range:10m])) - min by (session_id) (min_over_time(timestamp({__name__=~"claude_code_(token_usage_tokens|active_time_seconds|cost_usage_USD)_total", job="otel-collector"})[$__range:10m]))

panels.title: Cost by Source (main vs subagent vs auxiliary)

panels.description: Average true context window sent to the model per API request, broken down by model. Context window = input_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens (most context is served from cache, so input_tokens alone massively understates it). Auto-scaled to K via the 'short' unit.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} |= "claude_code.api_request" | unwrap input_tokens [$__interval]) by (model) + avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} |= "claude_code.api_request" | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__interval]) by (model) + avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} |= "claude_code.api_request" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__interval]) by (model)
